data.narrative:
Cortical Labs is a Series A-stage AI & Software company that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies, supplemented by reference to 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 additional private peers including Reflection AI, Scale AI, Figure AI, and Applied Intuition.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $11M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, implying a valuation of $22M. Peer-median analysis references the median valuation of the 5-company peer set at $5.6B, with a range spanning $2.0B (Field AI) to $29.0B (Scale AI). The wide peer range reflects heterogeneity in funding stage and business maturity within the AI & Software frontier-tech segment.

The triangulated range is $19M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $2.8B. The stage-progression method produces valuations materially below peer medians, suggesting either that Cortical Labs operates at earlier development phase than the comparable set or that peer valuations reflect significant premium multiples. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, product-market fit validation, and whether the peer set adequately reflects Cortical Labs' competitive positioning and technical differentiation within generative AI infrastructure.
